# Data cleaning and Updating Attributes

  select(fid, ADDRESSPOS) %>%

  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(demand = 100)

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}

  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  spread(destination_id, total_cost)%>%
  select(c(-c('origin_id')))
```

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}

```
:::



# Computing Handsen’s Accessibility


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
acc_Hansen <- data.frame(ac(hexagons$demand,
                            eldercare$capacity,
                            distmat_km, 
                            #d0 = 50,
                            power = 2, 
                            family = "Hansen"))
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
colnames(acc_Hansen) <- "accHansen"

acc_Hansen <- as_tibble(acc_Hansen)

hexagon_Hansen <- bind_cols(hexagons, acc_Hansen)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
acc_Hansen <- data.frame(ac(hexagons$demand,
                            eldercare$capacity,
                            distmat_km, 
                            #d0 = 50,
                            power = 0.5, 
                            family = "Hansen"))

colnames(acc_Hansen) <- "accHansen"
acc_Hansen <- as_tibble(acc_Hansen)
hexagon_Hansen <- bind_cols(hexagons, acc_Hansen)
```

# Visualising Accessibility


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# ensure packages
if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("ggplot2")
if (!requireNamespace("ggspatial", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("ggspatial")
if (!requireNamespace("scales", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("scales") # for alpha()

library(ggplot2)
library(ggspatial)
library(scales)

# ---- ensure map extent (mapex) exists ----
# Prefer hexagon_Hansen bbox; fall back to hexagons or eldercare if needed
if (!exists("mapex")) {
  if (exists("hexagon_Hansen")) {
    mapex <- sf::st_bbox(hexagon_Hansen)
  } else if (exists("hexagons")) {
    mapex <- sf::st_bbox(hexagons)
  } else if (exists("eldercare")) {
    mapex <- sf::st_bbox(eldercare)
  } else {
    stop("No object found to derive map extent. Provide hexagon_Hansen, hexagons, or eldercare.")
  }
  # expand bbox by 5% so edges are not clipped
  xpad <- (mapex["xmax"] - mapex["xmin"]) * 0.05
  ypad <- (mapex["ymax"] - mapex["ymin"]) * 0.05
  mapex["xmin"] <- mapex["xmin"] - xpad
  mapex["xmax"] <- mapex["xmax"] + xpad
  mapex["ymin"] <- mapex["ymin"] - ypad
  mapex["ymax"] <- mapex["ymax"] + ypad
}

# convert bbox values to numeric limits
xmin <- as.numeric(mapex["xmin"])
xmax <- as.numeric(mapex["xmax"])
ymin <- as.numeric(mapex["ymin"])
ymax <- as.numeric(mapex["ymax"])

# ---- plot ----
ggplot() +
  # hexagon fill (use hexagon_Hansen if available)
  geom_sf(
    data = if (exists("hexagon_Hansen")) hexagon_Hansen else hexagons,
    aes(geometry = geometry, fill = accHansen),
    colour = "black", size = 0.2
  ) +
  # eldercare points if available
  { if (exists("eldercare")) geom_sf(data = eldercare, aes(geometry = geometry),
                                     size = 0.6, shape = 21, fill = "white") } +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(xmin, xmax), ylim = c(ymin, ymax), expand = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", direction = -1,
                       name = "Accessibility\n(Hansen)", na.value = "grey80") +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.25) +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "tr", which_north = "true",
                         style = ggspatial::north_arrow_fancy_orienteering()) +
  labs(title = "Accessibility to eldercare: Hansen method") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.92, 0.8),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.6), colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.1, colour = "grey90")
  )
```
